standard: PCAF (2025). Global GHG Accounting and Reporting Standard Part A: Financed Emissions. Third Edition, §5.4 and §5.5.
note: PROVISIONAL, and it says so on every figure it produces. Building-energy intensities are order-of-magnitude figures drawn from published global ranges (CBECS, IEA, published Sri Lankan building-energy studies) at an indicative level — not a licensed dataset and not a national Sri Lankan measurement programme. Sri Lanka has no official building energy-label scheme, so Option 2a is rarely reachable on a Sri Lankan book and a figure will usually rest on Option 2b (type-and-floor-area statistics, score 4) or Option 3 (statistics per building, score 5). The label-class intensities below are illustrative for a country that adopts an equivalent certificate (fn 129); they are not a Sri Lankan scheme. Emission factors are provisional grid and fuel figures pending a released regional baseline.

electricity_grid.source: Indicative Sri Lanka grid emission factor (CEB generation mix); provisional pending a released baseline.

diesel.source: IPCC/DEFRA-range diesel combustion factor per kWh (net CV); provisional.

lpg.source: IPCC/DEFRA-range LPG combustion factor per kWh (net CV); provisional.

buildingTypes.label: Office
buildingTypes.source: Indicative office energy-use intensity, global temperate/tropical range; provisional.

buildingTypes.label: Hotel
buildingTypes.source: Indicative hotel energy-use intensity (24-hour operation, cooling load); provisional.

perBuildingFloorArea_m2.note: Option 3 has no floor area, only a building count, so a typical floor area per building type stands in. Provisional and indicative.

labelClasses.note: Illustrative label-class energy intensities for a country that adopts an official or equivalent certificate (Option 2a, fn 129). Not a Sri Lankan scheme; a book with no label cannot reach Option 2a.
